checks: Exact actual872 stable-build and frozen dependency guards precede any current-PDF measurement.
Checkpoint11 filename/bytes/SHA are fixed; all old PDF bytes are retrieved through existing CompactArchive object/logical APIs.
Only existing generate/apply_pdf_delta/deflate_size are used; no codec or renderer is introduced.
Both candidate partitions must contain16 unique targets and5 disjoint full bases over the same21 PDF hashes.
Only candidates with every target profitable are eligible; total unique stream bytes and all full-base payloads are counted.
All current input and archive identities are rechecked before any exclusive output write.
Outputs contain project-relative paths only and pass the unchanged privacy checker.
